hints: Two arrays: dist[] for best-known costs and done[] for vertices already settled. Never revisit a settled vertex.
Finding the minimum is a plain linear scan over unfinished vertices: if (!done[i] && (u == -1 || dist[i] < dist[u])) u = i;
Guard the relaxation with w[u][v] == NOEDGE. 999 is a marker meaning 'no edge', so treating it as a real cost invents roads that do not exist.
source: Core of NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 4 Practice Question 2
title: Dijkstra on an adjacency matrix
